# e-nvoice - Factur-X / EN 16931 Invoice Generator

> e-nvoice is a free, privacy-first, client-side web application for generating Factur-X / EN 16931 compliant electronic invoices (hybrid PDF/A-3 + UN/CEFACT XML) for French 2026 B2B/B2G regulations.

## Core Capabilities & Key Facts
- **Factur-X Standard**: Generates compliant hybrid PDF/A-3 documents embedded with `factur-x.xml` (UN/CEFACT CrossIndustryInvoice v100).
- **French 2026 Mandate Ready**: Fully satisfies the mandatory electronic invoicing requirements for France (EN 16931 & CIUS profiles).
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Zero data sent to external servers. All PDF and XML rendering occurs locally inside the user's browser.
- **WebMCP Integration (Beta)**: Exposes in-browser Model Context Protocol endpoints over `window.mcp` and `postMessage` for AI scripts and extensions.
- **Chorus Pro Compatible**: Generated Factur-X PDFs can be uploaded directly to the French government Chorus Pro portal (`portail.chorus-pro.gouv.fr`).

## Summary Technical Specifications
- Application URL: https://setiz.github.io/e-nvoice/
- Supported Profiles: Factur-X MINIMUM, BASIC, BASIC WL, EN 16931
- Underlying Formats: PDF/A-3 (ISO 19005-3), UN/CEFACT CII D16B XML
- Cost: 100% Free & Open Source (MIT License)
- Server Dependency: None (Runs completely in browser)

## AI Agent WebMCP Tools (`window.mcp.callTool()`)
- `calculate_invoice_totals`: Calculates subtotal HT, VAT totals, and total TTC from invoice line items.
- `validate_invoice_data`: Validates mandatory fields (invoice number, date, seller/buyer names, SIRET, VAT numbers, line items) against EN 16931 requirements.
- `generate_facturx_xml`: Generates raw Factur-X / EN 16931 XML string (UN/CEFACT CrossIndustryInvoice D16B).
- `generate_facturx_invoice`: Generates and triggers browser download of the complete Factur-X PDF/A-3 hybrid file.
